_note: W24-03, 2026-09-19. Every product fatade3d.md publishes in the seven catalogue categories and seven subcategories that content/catalog.json already holds, copied under ruling W24-R1, which reverses the wave 21 drop for TEXT DATA ONLY. W24-R2 is unchanged for files: no image, logo or asset from that host is in this repo, and none was downloaded. Method, counts and every field that could not be read are in docs/CATALOG-SOURCE-W24.md. SHAPE. `products` holds one record per product, keyed by `id`, never by `name`: ten names are used by two products each on the source. `categories` maps a repo category slug to the ids that category renders, a parent already rolled up over its subcategories. RENDERING. `name`, `variant` and `price.render` are what a card prints. `source` keeps the string as the host published it, unchanged, beside it. A null renders nothing: a null brand prints no brand line, a null variant prints no variant line, and a null price.render prints the W22-01 phrase, which W24-R3 narrowed to exactly that case. NEVER RENDERED: a name W17-02 refuses on a catalogue page. `brand` is null where the source brand is one, and `name` carries it removed, with the untouched original in `source.name`.

capture.method: WooCommerce Store API for ids, names, brands, prices and categories; the rendered category cards for the variant line; the WPML language switcher on each product page for the RO to RU link. docs/CATALOG-SOURCE-W24.md carries the requests and the counts.
